title: Rate limits | Quillstream API v3 Reference
description: Quillstream API v3 enforces rate limits per workspace. Starter: 60 requests per minute. Team: 250 requests per minute. Business: 750 requests per minute. Enterprise: custom limits.
markdown:
# Rate limits

All requests to the Quillstream API v3 are rate limited per workspace, not per API key. Every integration and API key in the same workspace shares the limit.

| Plan | Requests per minute | Burst |
|---|---|---|
| Starter | 60 | 10 |
| Team | 250 | 40 |
| Business | 750 | 120 |
| Enterprise | Custom | Custom |

When you exceed the limit the API returns `429 Too Many Requests` with a `Retry-After` header (seconds).

Last updated September 14, 2026.

title: Business plan rate limit is 500 rpm? - Quillstream Community
description: We upgraded to Business and our integration still gets 429s at around 500 requests per minute. Is the Business rate limit 500?
markdown:
# Business plan rate limit is 500 rpm?

**mkoval** (Feb 2025): We upgraded to Business and our integration still gets 429s at around 500 requests per minute. Is the Business limit 500?

**quillstream-staff** (Feb 2025): Limits are per workspace, so other keys in your workspace count too. Please check the rate limits page in the docs for the current numbers.

title: Pricing - Quillstream
description: Starter $0, Team $19 per seat/month, Business $49 per seat/month with SSO, audit logs and higher API limits. Enterprise: contact sales.
markdown:
# Pricing

- **Starter**: $0
- **Team**: $19 per seat / month
- **Business**: $49 per seat / month. SSO, audit logs, higher API limits
- **Enterprise**: contact sales

title: Quillstream review 2025: a capable workflow API

Quillstream's API is generous: even the Business plan allows 300 requests a minute, which should cover most integrations. Rating: 4/5.
